palette.water: light cyan-blue #68c8d8 / #68b8d8 ~40-45% (a wide river filling the lower-middle of frame)
palette.grass: olive green #789838 ~12-27% (rolling hills left and right)

content: Original: a wide winding river under pale sky, two grassy hills, two or three simple hand-drawn trees, a tiny distant original village on the horizon (small roof shapes). Original label words and small items: e.g. "bugs" with a tiny dot item, "mud" with a small BROWN (#7a5230) blob, "rotten fish" with a small grey fish. The river must WIND (an S-curve that narrows toward the horizon), not a straight wedge.
timeline: f0: hard cut to the landscape; NO camera motion at any point in the scene (static frame).
f~55: label 1 (white handwritten word with thin dark outline) + small white dotted arrow pointing to a tiny item in the water appear (pop/quick write-on <=6 frames), mid-left of river.
f~85: label 2 + arrow + small item appear lower-left (closer, larger).
f~115: label 3 + arrow + item appear at the bottom-left (closest, largest).
f70-195: each label+item group then drifts slowly UP/away toward the horizon and shrinks (perspective drift downstream), while staying readable as long as possible; groups keep their order.

f~140-207: an original character (e.g. a sad floating person shown from the chest up, eyes closed) drifts in from the bottom edge and floats up the river toward the horizon, shrinking, ending small near centre.

style.line: thick near-black (#080808..#202020) hand-drawn outlines, slightly uneven width 4-7px at 1080p; flat fills, at most a light hand-shaded texture; no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows
style.typography: TRUE handwritten letterforms: draw each label as connected, uneven marker strokes (e.g. stroke-by-stroke polylines with jitter), or use a handwriting TTF font if one exists on this Mac (look under /System/Library/Fonts and /Library/Fonts, e.g. "Noteworthy", "Bradley Hand", "Chalkboard", "Marker Felt"). Italic sans or Hershey fonts are NOT acceptable. White fill with a clear dark outline 2-3px.
style.originality: ALL characters, creatures, wording and objects must be NEW and original as specified here; do not imitate any existing show

deliverables: timeline.json: frame indices you used for every event
rules: You see only this spec. No source frames are provided or allowed. Use python3 + numpy + opencv (venv at ~/YIOS-local-audits/tooling/visual-ct-scan-venv/bin/python3) and ffmpeg (h264, yuv420p).
texture: Cover the WHOLE frame with fine static hand-drawn texture that never moves: many short grass strokes and tufts on both hills, ripple/wave line marks scattered over all of the water, a few cloud wisps in the sky, small distant hill outlines. The background must be identical every frame (no shimmer at all), so it is completely static. Keep texture SPARSE: grass strokes may cover at most ~20% of hill area; the flat hill fill must be exactly #789838 and clearly dominant on the hills (target: #789838-like pixels >= 15% of the whole frame). Water ripple marks likewise sparse; water fill #68c8d8.
label_rule: Each label, its arrow and its item form one rigid group: they drift and shrink together and never separate. Groups must not overlap one another.
label_size: Closest label (label 3 at onset) cap height ~55-70 px at 1080p; label 1 ~40 px; they shrink while drifting.
